en: Decorative early 20th‑century postcard with an Art Nouveau floral frame enclosing a black‑and‑white photo of a neoclassical city administration building bearing the sign "Городская управа." Hills and adjacent buildings appear in the background. Bilingual captions in Russian and German read "Владивостокъ / Wladiwostok" and "Городская управа. / Stadt‑Verwaltung." The back is undivided with Russian and French UPU headings.
